gloss: caught in the act; flagrante delicto

definitions.gloss: caught in the act; flagrante delicto; red-handed
definitions.explanation: A crime witnessed as it is being committed, or the person caught committing it. In Japanese law, anyone may arrest a person caught in the act of committing a crime (現行犯逮捕). Composed of 現行 (current, in progress) + 犯 (crime, criminal).

examples.japanese: {現行犯|げんこうはん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{万引|まんび}き→万引き：16838_manbiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{現行犯|げんこうはん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{捕|つか}まった→捕まる：01959_tsukamaru⟧。
examples.english: He was caught in the act of shoplifting.

examples.japanese: {現行犯|げんこうはん}⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{一般|いっぱん}→一般：01737_ippan⟧⟦{市民|しみん}→市民：01426_shimin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}する→逮捕する：26830_taihosuru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: In cases of flagrante delicto, even ordinary citizens can make an arrest.

notes:
USAGE:
{現行犯|げんこうはん} is used both for the crime caught in progress and for the person caught committing it. In Japanese law, {現行犯|げんこうはん}⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧ (arrest in flagrante delicto) is the only situation where a private citizen can legally arrest someone without a warrant.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {現行犯|げんこうはん}⟦{逮捕|たいほ}→逮捕：03397_taiho⟧ (arrest in the act)
- {現行犯|げんこうはん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{捕|つか}まる→捕まる：01959_tsukamaru⟧ (to be caught red-handed)
- {現行犯|げんこうはん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{逮捕|たいほ}する→逮捕する：26830_taihosuru⟧ (to arrest someone in the act)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{犯行|はんこう}→犯行：13472_hankou⟧⟦{現場|げんば}→現場：02723_genba⟧ means crime scene. {現行犯|げんこうはん} specifically refers to being caught during the criminal act itself.
